about: A decision at round r may read only what is observable at t = 4r h (T11, g1 'clairvoyant policy rejected'). Two guards. (1) The PolicyView: every leaf of the world a policy can reach carries available_at; reading a leaf whose available_at is later than t (or 'never': scenario parameters, the rng, other branches) raises AnticipationViolation naming the path. (2) The paired-history check: on a scenario tree, two scenarios whose observable histories are identical through round r must get identical decisions at r; it catches a policy that reaches the future through a side channel and never touches the view. LF-1, from round 0, rules world (no agents needed).
observability_rules: a pending_in's expected_h is observable from the snapshot's as_of (t=0)

a pending_in expected at t whose arrival is not delivered in step 2 of the round at t is marked overdue before step 4 and is observable from that round; its true arrival time is observable only when it arrives
a public post is observable from the round it is published
a C2 result is observable the round after it is issued
scenario parameters, scheduled future events, the rng state and any other branch are never observable

policies.how: closes over the scenario object outside the view; draws at round 0 only where the receipt will be late

expect.reason: decisions differ on identical observable history

expect_all.every_rejection_names: the path, or for a side channel the first round and the scenario pair
